name: LineShine
comment: LineShine (Chinese: 灵晟, pinyin: Lingsheng) is an all-CPU Chinese exascale supercomputer at NSCS Shenzhen, based on the LingKun architecture with LX2 CPUs (ARMv9, SVE+SME). Ranked #1 on TOP500 and HPCG in June 2026: 2,198.40 PFLOPS Rmax / 2,735.82 PFLOPS Rpeak (FP64), 42.22 MW, 52.07 FP64 GFLOPS/W. Unveiled 27 April 2026; deployment and completion in 1H 2026. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LineShine

parts.name: LineShine Compute Partition
parts.comment: 22,680 compute nodes (2x LX2 each) in ~90 compute cabinets (2 frames x 16 blades x 8 nodes). Node count derived from 13,789,440 LX2 cores / 304 cores per CPU / 2 CPUs per node. System integrator not publicly disclosed (TBD). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LineShine

cpus.name: LX2
cpus.comment: LX2: 2 compute dies x 152 ARMv9 cores (SVE+SME), up to 60.3 TFLOPS FP64 / 120.6 TFLOPS FP32 per CPU. Manufacturer not publicly disclosed (TBD). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LineShine

node_types.comment: 22,680 identical all-CPU nodes (no accelerators), 2x LX2 each. LingQi network: dual-plane multi-rail fat-tree, 1.6 Tb/s per node, 4 layers, single-hop latency 1.07 us, bisection bandwidth > 3.5 Pb/s. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LineShine
